title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Workforce Development Board/ Local Elected Officials four-year agreement.
text:
[Council File 26-1630]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Workforce Development Board/ Local Elected Officials four-year agreement.
Recommendation for Council action:
AUTHORIZE the Mayor to execute the Workforce Development Board (WDB)/Local Elected Officials (LEO) agreement attached to the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA) report dated November 10, 2026, attached to the Council file, which will become effective January 1, 2027.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
TIME LIMIT FILE - JANUARY 9, 2027 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - JANUARY 8, 2027
summary: Council authorizes the Mayor to sign a four-year agreement between the Workforce Development Board and the Local Elected Officials, effective January 1, 2027.
